items.title: Marmot Researchers Turn to OnlyFans for Funding—And There Are Meme Coins Too
items.summary: Scientists are using OnlyFans to help fund decades of marmot research, while unofficial memecoins inspired by the project have emerged on Solana.

items.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
items.summary: BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund for stablecoin reserves that uses Solana alongside Ethereum.

items.title: Inside Solana’s Growing Market for Tokenized Cards and Physical Collectibles
items.summary: Collector Crypt has crossed $1.6B in volume as Solana apps bring vaulted cards, packs, buybacks, and physical redemption onchain.

items.title: Overview of Institutional Real World Assets on Solana
items.summary: Learn how BlackRock, J.P. Morgan, Visa, Franklin Templeton, and other institutions are building the future of tokenized real-world assets on Solana.

items.title: Solana Changelog: Mainnet raises block limits to 100M CUs
items.summary: SIMD-0286 activated on mainnet to raise block limits to 100M CUs, alongside new Agave, Firedancer, SDK, and LiteSVM releases.

items.title: What are Preconfirmations (Preconfs) on Solana?
items.summary: Preconfirmations (preconfs) are the earliest transaction signal on Solana, streamed the moment a leader executes a transaction. Learn how they work

items.title: Setting Up Subscriptions and Recurring Payments on Solana
items.summary: Build onchain subscriptions on Solana with Helius. Learn how to create plans, collect payments, and manage renewals.

items.title: Solana Changelog: July 23, 2026
items.summary: The Resource and Inclusion Fees SIMD was accepted alongside new Agave, Firedancer, and program SDK releases.

items.title: Deploying enterprise stablecoin rails on Solana in days with Crossmint
items.summary: Read how Crossmint’s Solana infrastructure supports Western Union USDPT, fomo’s $4B volume, Tala wallets, and Wirex smart wallets.

items.title: Rent Reduction on Solana: A Data-Backed Analysis
items.summary: A data-backed analysis of whether Solana can reduce the rent-exempt requirement from 6,960 to 696 lamports per byte without creating immediate state-growth risk, covering attack economics, account persistence, AccountsDB growth, and payment onboarding costs.

items.title: Solana Changelog: July 16, 2026
items.summary: Agave, Firedancer, Frankendancer, Solana Program JS SDKs, LiteSVM, Mollusk, and Surfpool shipped new releases.

items.title: The Sun Rises in Seoul and Trades on Solana: $SKHY is Now Live
items.summary: SK Hynix ($SKHY), South Korea’s dominant memory-chip maker, is now live on Solana.

items.title: What is RocksDB? The Embedded Key-Value Store
items.summary: RocksDB is an embeddable, persistent key-value store optimized for fast storage. Learn how it works and how it’s used at a global scale

items.title: Solana Changelog: July 9, 2026
items.summary: New Agave, Firedancer, and Superbank releases landed alongside Solana Go v2.0.0-rc and LiteSVM v0.13.1.
